access.note: Free public, lookup by NIP. SENSITIVE PERSONAL DATA (names, PESEL) — GDPR; minimize/redact.

pagination.note: Lookup by NIP. Confirm the exact public API/endpoint shape from crbr.podatki.gov.pl (the UI offers PDF + structured export).

snapshot.note: Persist raw to the restricted raw zone; minimize PII before promotion.

parsing.notes: Beneficial owners are natural persons (PII). DO NOT persist PESEL beyond raw — minimize to birth year. Join by NIP.

mapping_rules.beneficial_owners: beneficjenci[] -> owners[] with name (minimized), citizenship, ownership_nature.
mapping_rules.matching: Join by NIP to the company spine.
mapping_rules.pii_policy: Redact/minimize PESEL; default to birth year.

fixture_requirements: entity with multiple beneficial owners + ownership %

live_test_plan.smoke: Look up a known NIP; assert beneficjenci[] present; verify PII minimization applied before promotion.
live_test_plan.full: Seed NIPs from the spine; look up CRBR per NIP; persist raw to restricted zone; promote minimized owners[]; throttle.

blockers: Sensitive PII (names, PESEL) — strict GDPR handling / minimization required.
